BiblicalUsage: The sense of sâphan is to conceal (as a valuable). It stands in Deuteronomy 33:19: "…mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God put sâphan here on purpose, and I take his word for it.
